name: Trivariate Cubic Polynomial Approximation for Scalar Fields
definition: A method to model 3D scalar field data (e.g., CT/MRI) by approximating subcubes of a cuberille volume with trivariate cubic polynomial functions that achieve C1 continuity on shared faces, providing a compact analytic representation for isosurface generation.
summary: Trivariate cubic polynomial approximation models 3D scalar fields with C1 continuous cubic functions to generate smooth isosurfaces, distinguishing itself by avoiding polygon shading artifacts like Mach ringing.
